Action: write_file
Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/melting/brief/subtasks/copper_nvt_subtask_melting_trial_0/in.nvt", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Copper NVT equilibration

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Create simple FCC copper structure
lattice fcc 3.615
region box block 0 1 0 1 0 1
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box
replicate 5 5 5

# Define mass
mass 1 63.546

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy Cu

# Energy Minimization
minimize 1.0e-4 1.0e-6 1000 10000

# Settings
timestep 1.0

# Initialize velocities
velocity all create 300.0 4928459 dist gaussian

# NVT equilibration
fix 1 all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 100.0

# Output settings
compute myTemp all temp
compute myPress all pressure myTemp
compute myPE all pe
variable vol equal vol
variable tmass equal mass(all)
variable density equal v_tmass/v_vol*1.6605e-24

thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp pe ke etotal press v_density

# Run NVT
run 10000

# Write final configuration
write_data nvt_equilibrated.data

# Print final density
print "Final_density: ${density}""}
